title: 새해 복 많이 받으세요! Happy New Year! See You Soon
description:
#문별이다 #문별 #별의문단속 #BYULtheGatekeeper  
#MoonByul #MOONBYUL  

Hello everyone, this is MOON BYUL!

Thank you so, so much for being with us on 'BYUL the Gatekeeper' throughout 2025 💛

I had such a wonderful time meeting nearly 30 amazing guests,
laughing together, talking about all kinds of stories,
and sharing so many meaningful moments.
Thanks to all of you who joined us,
this year truly felt special and unforgettable to me.

I hope 2026 brings you lots of happiness, good health,
and nothing but wonderful things ahead!

'BYUL the Gatekeeper' will be back with a brand-new season,
so please look forward to it and stay with us until then 💫

And if you’d like to visit 'Byul the Gatekeeper' someday,
we’re always open—so don’t hesitate to reach out!

Until we meet again in 2026,
Bye for now! 👋💙
